# osapi behavior chain

Show and check the chains of behaviors that a behavior calls.
`osapi cli command get --name behavior chain` shows the same.

## Group

|             |                                                              |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Name        | behavior chain                                               |
| Description | Show and check the chains of behaviors that a behavior calls |
